proposals.title: Revisit Executive Pay Incentives for GHG Emission Reductions
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Compensation Committee to revisit executive pay incentives and consider eliminating greenhouse gas reduction targets and other scientifically dubious goals from compensation.
proposals.evidence: The Board carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote AGAINST it.

proposals.title: Additional Pay Report on Gender and Racial Basis
proposals.topic_summary: Asks ExxonMobil to report quantitative median and adjusted pay gaps across race and gender, including associated risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote AGAINST it.

proposals.title: Report on Plastic Production Under SCS Scenario
proposals.topic_summary: Asks for a report on how a significant reduction in virgin plastic demand under Breaking the Plastic Wave's System Change Scenario would affect the Company's financial position.
proposals.evidence: The Board carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote AGAINST it.

proposals.title: Additional Social Impact Report
proposals.proponent: United Steelworkers, Paper and Forestry, Rubber, Manufacturing, Energy, Allied Industrial and Service Workers International Union
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on social impact on workers and communities from facility closures or energy transition, and mitigation alternatives.
proposals.evidence: The Board carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote AGAINST it.
